comparison_table.measurement_boundary: request_scope encloses _reported_dispatch; model_attempt_timing.window_ms uses a clipped union of completed MODEL_ATTEMPT intervals. Actual transport.py is unchanged.

comparison_table.comparison_forbidden: Do not call MODEL_ATTEMPT union pure network/inference, or subtract it from request_scope_ms without checking identical end boundaries. Do not infer full-service improvement from saved-wire schema microbenchmark.

comparison_table.measurement_boundary: timing.service.returning marks normalized_request_to_return_scheduled before DeferredReport.__exit__/enqueue. timing.report.worker_finished follows finalize cleanup.
comparison_table.includes: Service marker includes dispatch and probe teardown already returned; worker lifetime includes report/TXT/trace and context cleanup.
comparison_table.excludes_or_unknown: The scheduled-return marker is not final Python service return; queue/finalizer work can overlap return and other work.
comparison_table.comparison_allowed: Join by request_id and show enqueue/worker start/finish separately alongside an external service timer.
comparison_table.comparison_forbidden: Do not sum finalizer duration into response wall or use the scheduled-return marker as complete service_wall_ms.
